card.name: Length of time something lasts
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside a stated length of time, such as 'for', 'hours', 'follow' (up), 'worn', or 'short' (term). Seen in wear times, dosing intervals and study durations.

modes.label: Wear or dosing time
modes.description: Words around hours of wear or the interval between doses.
modes.example: It is usually worn<< for>> 24 hours, even while sleeping

modes.label: Study duration
modes.description: Words in descriptions of how long a trial or follow-up lasted.
modes.example: The mean duration of<< follow>>-up was 4.7 years.

modes.label: Number plus time unit
modes.description: The time unit after a number, in a dosing or monitoring period.
modes.example: The dosing interval for fentanyl transdermal system is 72<< hours>>.

card.writes: It promotes words about duration, trials, simulation and time spans, mostly Chinese terms, and suppresses unrelated code and character pieces.
card.plain: It lights up when the text is about how long something is worn, given or followed.
